description: This is a Java test class for the SuggestionsProvider component in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It contains unit tests verifying dictionary setup, suggestion retrieval, auto-text creation, incognito mode behavior, and dictionary loading interactions.

classes.name: SuggestionsProviderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the SuggestionsProvider component, including dictionary setup, suggestion retrieval, auto-text creation, and incognito mode behavior.

classes.name: WordsHolder
classes.description: A callback implementation that collects words received from dictionary suggestions for verification in tests.

classes.name: FakeBuilder
classes.description: A mock implementation of DictionaryAddOnAndBuilder used to simulate dictionary and auto-text creation with predefined words.

classes.name: FakeBTreeDictionary
classes.description: A mock dictionary class that loads predefined words for testing purposes.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and the SuggestionsProvider instance before each test.

methods.name: testDoesNotCreateDictionariesWhenPassingNullBuilder
methods.description: Verifies that no dictionaries are created when setup is called with an empty builder list.

methods.name: testSetupSingleDictionaryBuilder
methods.description: Tests that a single dictionary builder creates the dictionary, auto-text, and initial suggestions, and that suggestions are retrieved correctly.

methods.name: testDiscardIfNoChangesInDictionaries
methods.description: Ensures that dictionaries are not recreated or closed if no changes are detected.

methods.name: testDoesNotDiscardIfPrefQuickFixChanged
methods.description: Checks that changing the quick fix preference triggers dictionary recreation and closure.

methods.name: testDoesNotDiscardIfPrefContactsChanged
methods.description: Verifies that changing contact dictionary preference triggers dictionary recreation and closure.

methods.name: testDoesNotDiscardIfCloseCalled
methods.description: Ensures that calling close does not cause errors and dictionaries are closed properly.

methods.name: testMultipleSetupSingleDictionaryBuilder
methods.description: Tests setup with multiple builders and verifies suggestions from all dictionaries.

methods.name: testLookupDelegation
methods.description: Verifies that auto-text lookup is delegated to the correct auto-text object.

methods.name: testDoesNotLearnWhenIncognito
methods.description: Checks that learning new words and next-word suggestions are disabled in incognito mode.

methods.name: testLookupWhenNullAutoTextDelegation
methods.description: Ensures that if auto-text creation returns null, lookup calls are skipped.

methods.name: testDoesNotCreateAutoText
methods.description: Verifies that auto-text is not created when the quick fix preference is disabled.

methods.name: testDoesNotCreateAutoTextForSecondaries
methods.description: Checks that secondary dictionaries do not create auto-text when the preference is disabled.

methods.name: testDoesCreateAutoTextForSecondaries
methods.description: Verifies that secondary dictionaries create auto-text when the preference is enabled.

methods.name: testIsValid
methods.description: Tests the word validation logic before and after setup, and after closing the provider.

methods.name: wordFor
methods.description: Helper method to create a WordComposer from a string.

methods.name: testCloseWillConvertAllDictionariesToEmptyDictionaries
methods.description: Ensures that closing the provider clears all suggestions.

methods.name: testDoesNotCrashIfCloseIsCalledBeforeLoadIsDone
methods.description: Verifies that calling close before dictionary load completes does not cause crashes.

methods.name: testClearDictionariesBeforeClosingDictionaries
methods.description: Checks that dictionaries are cleared before closing.

methods.name: testPassesWordsLoadedListenerToDictionaries
methods.description: Verifies that the dictionary loading listener is called appropriately for all dictionaries.

methods.name: testPassesWordsLoadedListenerToDictionariesEvenIfSameBuilders
methods.description: Ensures that the listener is called correctly even when setup is called with the same builders again.
